about.title: About Us
about.description: At Adala Legal Office, we believe that justice is a right for all. We are dedicated to providing comprehensive legal services with high quality and professional standards. Our areas of expertise include criminal cases, civil lawsuits, legal consultations, and legal representation before all courts and official institutions. Our team includes a select group of experienced lawyers and consultants united by a common goal: to defend our clients’ rights and offer effective legal solutions tailored to each case.

services.title: What We Offer
services.description: Explore a wide range of legal services designed to support individuals and businesses with professional and reliable legal expertise.

legal_claims.name: Legal Claims
legal_claims.text: Comprehensive legal representation in personal status cases such as divorce, alimony, custody, and inheritance.

criminal_cases.name: Criminal Cases
criminal_cases.text: Defense before criminal courts in all matters related to felonies and criminal offenses.

immigration.name: Residency & Immigration
immigration.text: Legal services for obtaining residency, travel visas, and resolving immigration issues.

contracts.name: Commercial Contracts
contracts.text: Drafting and reviewing commercial contracts to protect your business interests.

companies.name: Companies
companies.text: Company formation, partnership agreements, and resolving commercial disputes.

customs.name: Customs
customs.text: Handling customs cases and disputes related to border and import/export transactions.

consultation.name: Legal Consultations
consultation.text: Clear and quick legal advice tailored to your case.
